name: @subs-initiative/owner-spec-lint
description: Enforces the OWNER-SPEC convention. Per-PR coupling check (warn when tool source changes without OWNER-SPEC touch) + nightly staleness report (max_unattested_days elapsed AND tool churn since last_attested).
//: No dependencies. tsx + vitest picked up from workspace via npx. Intentionally outside npm workspaces graph (same pattern as state-derive, hive-board-derive, attestation-derive).
